description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on your client. The token must contain only ASCII characters and be no more than 64 characters in length.

#### Conditions

This operation can be used to change the resource group of only zone-specific resources.
